translations.web: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
translations.bsb: It was because you Levites were not with us the first time that the LORD our God burst forth in anger against us. For we did not consult Him about the proper order.”
translations.kjv: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
translations.asv: For because ye bare it not at the first, Jehovah our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not according to the ordinance.
